column1: ## QSSI 2026 Adversarial Testing and Robustness Assessment

This file contains the objective CRITIC (Criteria Importance Through Intercriteria Correlation) weighting structure used within the Quantum Sovereign Security Index (QSSI) 2026 computational framework.
The CRITIC methodology derives indicator importance from both variability and inter-indicator conflict, producing statistically grounded weights without subjective expert assignment.
The resulting weights quantify the relative contribution of each sovereign security dimension to the overall QSSI composite index.
The sampling adequacy exceeds accepted multivariate analytical thresholds and supports composite index construction.
The null hypothesis of an identity correlation matrix is rejected, confirming statistically significant interrelationships among indicators.
The composite framework demonstrates strong internal consistency and high measurement reliability.

All reported CRITIC weights are derived from the finalized harmonized QSSI 2026 sovereign dataset containing 90 countries and four validated security dimensions. Results are fully reproducible through the published computational framework, associated audit records, and archived DOI releases.
